name: DecodingTrust
description: DecodingTrust is a comprehensive benchmark evaluating the trustworthiness of GPT models, focusing on aspects such as toxicity, stereotype bias, adversarial robustness, privacy, machine ethics, and fairness. It reveals vulnerabilities in GPT-3.5 and GPT-4, including susceptibility to toxic outputs and privacy leaks.
reputation: Widely cited as a leading trustworthiness benchmark for GPT-style models and commonly used in safety-oriented evaluations.
notes: Focuses on multiple trustworthiness dimensions including toxicity, bias, privacy, and ethics; benchmark and dataset publicly available.
